title: Neurodiagnostic Technology
author: Dayone Koo
_comment: PROGRAM EVALUATION of a program NOT YET OFFERED: Foothill College x TOP 121200 (Electro-Neurodiagnostic Technology), a two-year A.S. in partnership with UCSF, first cohort expected fall 2027 (Mountain View Voice, September 2026). Foothill has no COCI award, no awards, no enrollment and no courses for it yet, so this def uses the program-not-yet-offered fields (planned_awards, wage_note, crosswalk_chain, extra_colleges + programs + supply_scope). Destination: crosswalk(121200) = {25-1071, 29-2099, 99-9999}; the derivation rule drops 29-2099 as ALL_OTHER, so the destination is AUTHORED with the CIP chain as justification — TOP 1212.00 -> CIP 51.0903 -> SOC 29-2099, whose detailed O*NET occupation 29-2099.01 Neurodiagnostic Technologists is what the program prepares for. The demand section carries the COE figure for the 29-2099 bucket (Bay: 530 openings/yr) with one sentence placing 29-2099.01 inside it. Comparators are the two California colleges with active awards under the TOP, Orange Coast (A.S. 08657, OC region) and San Diego Mesa (A.S. 38642 + CoA 38643, SD/I region), so the supply section is statewide and draws no regional openings rule. Their courses are read from their Course Outlines of Record (Coast CCD CourseLeaf catalog; SDCCD CurriQunet META All Fields report). live_postings from tools/jobs/scrape_jobs.cjs 29-2099.01 94022 50 (7 hits; the 3 neurodiagnostic-titled ones kept, 4 polysomnography titles set aside). competencies: O*NET 29-2099.01 description; K/S/A from occupations.competencies for 29-2099 (the .01 specialty's ratings).
chain_note: Foothill's program is classified under TOP 1212.00. The state's crosswalk carries that code to CIP 51.0903 and on to SOC 29-2099; the occupation the program prepares for is the detailed O*NET code inside that SOC, 29-2099.01 Neurodiagnostic Technologists.

lede: This evaluation assembles labor-market supply and demand evidence for Foothill College's planned Neurodiagnostic Technology program (TOP 121200): regional demand for the occupation it is designed for, the award and enrollment trends of the California colleges already offering the program, and how their courses align with the work of that occupation.
demand_note: Neurodiagnostic Technologists (O*NET 29-2099.01) are reported within SOC 29-2099, Health Technologists and Technicians, All Other. [According to the Centers of Excellence](https://datastudio.google.com/u/0/reporting/5060057c-b9ba-4081-9ed7-83356eaa7061), this classification has roughly 530 openings a year in the Bay Area.
alignment_note: The two California colleges with active awards under TOP 121200. Each supports SOC 29-2099 through the same TOP–CIP–SOC crosswalk.

enrollment_note: Enrollment each term in each college's program. An empty cell means DataMart reported no data; n/a marks a term the college's calendar does not have.
